preserve-meaning.instruction: Preserve facts, numbers, units, negation, conditions, exceptions, uncertainty, quotations, citations, and code at every level.

reader-need.instruction: Select the document type from the reader need and preserve an explicit type choice.

type-contract.instruction: Keep the selected type focused on learning, task completion, factual lookup, or understanding.

separate-and-link.instruction: Move substantial material serving another need into a linked destination only within the requested restructuring scope.

reader-check.instruction: Check the result against the actual reader activity rather than the presence of four headings.
